news.title: Zyphor OS beta ISO is ready to test
news.author: Mark Jason P. Espelita
news.summary: The first public beta ISO is available for testers on real hardware and virtual machines.
content: The beta ISO boots to a live desktop and includes the installer, first-boot setup and the default tools.
We are asking testers to try it in a virtual machine first, then on spare hardware, and report anything that looks wrong.
Bug reports with the output of the system info command are the most useful kind.
